decisions.decision: Register and immediately gate W256/D16 for 60 epochs after preserving and cancelling W256/D10.
decisions.evidence: Explicit user request; exact static parameter count is 20,192,451.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not run W256/D10 and D16 concurrently, reuse partial weights, or silently change batch/LR.

decisions.decision: Pass all staged gates and start W256/D16 for 60 epochs.
decisions.evidence: Compiled batch4 peak reserved 20274 MiB, finite loss 5.672654, positive throughput, dataset hash and CUDA/unit gates passed.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not reduce batch, enable checkpointing, reuse D10 weights or change optimizer settings.

decisions.decision: Invalidate and stop the first D16 run, implement opt-in true linear warmup plus gradient clipping, and restart only after re-audit.
decisions.evidence: Epoch2-to-3 loss increased 12.62% and P1 regressed 104.24 mm; configured warmup was unused, while checkpoint tensors remained finite.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not continue an optimizer-unstable run, resume its checkpoint, silently change legacy experiments, or attribute the spike to corruption without evidence.

decisions.decision: Pass R2 preflight and restart W256/D16 from random initialization with true warmup and gradient clipping.
decisions.evidence: All staged gates pass; batch4 uses 35496 warmup steps, starts near 5e-5 LR, has finite pre-clip grad norm 44.925 and reserves 20406 MiB.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not reuse R1 checkpoint, overwrite its directory, disable clipping, or modify legacy configs.

decisions.decision: Invalidate and stop D16 R2 at epoch 16 under the registered fail-closed rule; preserve all four checkpoints and prohibit automatic retry.
decisions.evidence: Epoch 15-to-16 loss rose 121.5 percent and EMA P1 regressed 92.8847 mm. All raw/EMA checkpoint tensors remain finite. wh PID 691656 overlapped part of epoch 16, so causality remains unresolved.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not resume epoch 16, report epoch 15 as a completed result, delete the invalid run, blame the concurrent process without a controlled diagnostic, or change configuration automatically.

decisions.decision: Create a fresh R3 with lower cosine-decayed LR, intended SSM no-decay grouping and explicit update telemetry, then restart only after re-audit and staged preflight.
decisions.evidence: R2 raw parameters moved 8.72 percent in one epoch at LR 4.66e-4; warmup delayed but did not remove the excursion, and the single AdamW group ignored existing no-weight-decay markers.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not resume invalid R2, alter architecture or losses before isolating optimizer scale, automatically stop finite metric movement, or overwrite prior runs.
